title: Tribocatalytic degradation of concentrated methyl orange solutions by BiFeO3 nanoparticles prepared through a sol–gel method
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23089-23096
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02423D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanhong Gu, Weiying Zhang, Yuen Li, Kelan Wang, Lanlan Ge, Xianghui Zhang, Jianguo Zhao, Zhenjiang Shen, Wanping Chen, Yaohua Hu
The BiFeO3 nanopowders were applied in the degradation of highly concentrated methyl orange dye through friction catalysis. The mechanism involves electron transitions, with the holes in the valence band participating in the degradation process.
